meanings.en: lasting forever; that cannot be destroyed or forgotten
meanings.exampleEn: Her contribution to science earned her an imperishable reputation.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilime katkısı ona yok olmaz bir itibar kazandırdı.

meanings.en: able to be destroyed
meanings.exampleEn: The packaging is made from a fully destructible material that breaks down over time.
meanings.exampleTr: Ambalaj, zamanla parçalanan tamamen yok edilebilir bir malzemeden yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: not showing careful judgement or good taste in choices
meanings.exampleEn: An undiscriminating reader will enjoy almost any book you hand them.
meanings.exampleTr: Seçici olmayan bir okur, kendisine verilen hemen her kitaptan keyif alır.

meanings.en: careful about choosing only the best or most suitable things
meanings.exampleEn: She is very selective about the projects she agrees to work on.
meanings.exampleTr: Üzerinde çalışmayı kabul ettiği projeler konusunda çok seçicidir.

meanings.en: not clear in outline or detail
meanings.exampleEn: The photo was blurred because the camera moved.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamera oynadığı için fotoğraf bulanık çıktı.

meanings.en: made less distinct or clear-cut
meanings.exampleEn: The line between work and home has become blurred since we started working remotely.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzaktan çalışmaya başladığımızdan beri iş ile ev arasındaki sınır belirsizleşti.

meanings.en: a person whose job is to make or alter clothes, especially men's suits
meanings.exampleEn: He took the suit to a tailor to have the sleeves shortened.
meanings.exampleTr: Kolları kısaltmak için takım elbiseyi bir terziye götürdü.

meanings.en: to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person
meanings.exampleEn: We can tailor the course to meet your team's specific needs.
meanings.exampleTr: Kursu ekibinizin özel ihtiyaçlarını karşılayacak şekilde uyarlayabiliriz.

meanings.en: showing great care, attention, and effort
meanings.exampleEn: Her assiduous research uncovered details everyone else had missed.
meanings.exampleTr: Titiz araştırması, herkesin gözden kaçırdığı ayrıntıları ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: wanting to avoid activity or effort; lazy
meanings.exampleEn: He spent an indolent afternoon lying in the hammock.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğleden sonrasını hamakta uzanarak tembel tembel geçirdi.

meanings.en: the quality of using more of something than is necessary
meanings.exampleEn: The report criticized the wastefulness of the old heating system.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, eski ısıtma sisteminin savurganlığını eleştirdi.

meanings.en: great skill or proficiency at doing something
meanings.exampleEn: Her adeptness at handling difficult clients impressed the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor müşterileri idare etmedeki ustalığı tüm ekibi etkiledi.

meanings.en: fair and impartial; treating everyone equally
meanings.exampleEn: They sought an equitable distribution of the company's profits.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket kârının adil bir şekilde dağıtılmasını istediler.

meanings.en: the force or speed gained by a moving object or a developing process
meanings.exampleEn: The campaign gained momentum after the celebrity endorsement.
meanings.exampleTr: Kampanya, ünlü desteğinden sonra ivme kazandı.

meanings.en: the quantity of motion of a moving body, equal to mass times velocity
meanings.exampleEn: In physics, momentum is conserved in a closed system.
meanings.exampleTr: Fizikte kapalı bir sistemde momentum korunur.

meanings.en: the period of a person's life when they are a baby
meanings.exampleEn: She has been friends with him since babyhood.
meanings.exampleTr: Onunla bebeklik döneminden beri arkadaş.

meanings.en: sex between a married person and someone who is not their husband or wife
meanings.exampleEn: He admitted to committing adultery during their marriage.
meanings.exampleTr: Evlilikleri sırasında zina yaptığını itiraf etti.

meanings.en: the quality of stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: His obstinacy made it impossible to reach a compromise.
meanings.exampleTr: İnatçılığı, bir uzlaşmaya varmayı imkânsız kıldı.

meanings.en: a relaxed and unconcerned manner or attitude
meanings.exampleEn: The casualness with which he broke the news shocked everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Haberi verirkenki kayıtsızlığı herkesi şaşkına çevirdi.

meanings.en: correct or formal behaviour that follows accepted rules
meanings.exampleEn: There was a certain formality in the way the guests were greeted.
meanings.exampleTr: Konukların karşılanış biçiminde belirli bir resmiyet vardı.

meanings.en: something that must be done as part of a process but has little real importance
meanings.exampleEn: Signing the last document was just a formality.
meanings.exampleTr: Son belgeyi imzalamak sadece bir formaliteydi.

meanings.en: the ability to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties
meanings.exampleEn: Her resourcefulness saved the project when the funding was cut.
meanings.exampleTr: Fon kesildiğinde becerikliliği projeyi kurtardı.

meanings.en: the quality of lacking imagination or new ideas
meanings.exampleEn: The unimaginativeness of the design left the judges unimpressed.
meanings.exampleTr: Tasarımın hayal gücünden yoksunluğu jüriyi etkilemedi.

meanings.en: to pull a plant and its roots out of the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The storm uprooted several old trees in the park.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına parktaki birkaç yaşlı ağacı kökünden söktü.

meanings.en: to force someone to leave the place where they live
meanings.exampleEn: The war uprooted thousands of families from their homes.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş binlerce aileyi evlerinden söküp attı.

meanings.en: extremely cruel and shocking
meanings.exampleEn: The prisoners were treated in a barbaric manner.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkumlara barbarca davranıldı.

meanings.en: a small hotel or private house offering accommodation to paying guests
meanings.exampleEn: We stayed in a cosy little guesthouse near the coast.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahile yakın şirin küçük bir pansiyonda kaldık.

meanings.en: working or having effect; in operation
meanings.exampleEn: The new regulations become operative next month.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni düzenlemeler gelecek ay yürürlüğe girecek.

meanings.en: most relevant or significant (as in 'the operative word')
meanings.exampleEn: He said he 'might' come, and 'might' is the operative word.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Belki' geleceğini söyledi, ve buradaki anahtar kelime 'belki'.

meanings.en: to an excessive or unnecessary degree
meanings.exampleEn: You shouldn't be unduly worried about the test results.
meanings.exampleTr: Test sonuçları için gereğinden fazla endişelenmemelisin.

meanings.en: the ability to appreciate and respond to complex emotional or aesthetic influences
meanings.exampleEn: The film appeals to a modern sensibility.
meanings.exampleTr: Film modern bir duyarlılığa hitap ediyor.

meanings.en: a person's feelings that may be easily offended or hurt
meanings.exampleEn: The joke offended the sensibilities of some viewers.
meanings.exampleTr: Şaka bazı izleyicilerin hassasiyetlerini incitti.

meanings.en: the act of fixing or inserting something into a place, especially in the body
meanings.exampleEn: The implantation of the pacemaker took less than an hour.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalp pilinin yerleştirilmesi bir saatten az sürdü.

meanings.en: the process by which a fertilized egg attaches to the wall of the uterus
meanings.exampleEn: Implantation usually occurs about a week after fertilization.
meanings.exampleTr: Rahim duvarına tutunma genellikle döllenmeden yaklaşık bir hafta sonra gerçekleşir.

meanings.en: the quality of lacking good taste or being inappropriate
meanings.exampleEn: The tastelessness of his remarks embarrassed the whole table.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözlerinin zevksizliği bütün masayı utandırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of having no flavour
meanings.exampleEn: The tastelessness of the soup suggested it had no seasoning.
meanings.exampleTr: Çorbanın tatsızlığı, hiç baharat konmadığını gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: a pleasantly sharp or appetizing taste, or an exciting quality
meanings.exampleEn: A dash of lime added piquancy to the dish.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir tutam misket limonu yemeğe keskin bir çeşni kattı.

meanings.en: great enthusiasm and energy
meanings.exampleEn: She approached every new challenge with real zest.
meanings.exampleTr: Her yeni zorluğa gerçek bir hevesle yaklaşırdı.

meanings.en: the outer coloured part of the peel of citrus fruit, used for flavour
meanings.exampleEn: Add a little lemon zest to the batter for extra flavour.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekstra lezzet için hamura biraz limon kabuğu rendesi ekleyin.

meanings.en: rude and disrespectful behaviour or speech
meanings.exampleEn: She was shocked by the impertinence of his question.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorusunun küstahlığı karşısında şoke oldu.

meanings.en: rude and disrespectful behaviour, especially towards someone senior
meanings.exampleEn: He had the impudence to demand a raise on his first day.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk gününde zam istemek küstahlığını gösterdi.

meanings.en: referring back to the subject of a sentence, as with reflexive pronouns
meanings.exampleEn: In 'she taught herself', 'herself' is a reflexive pronoun.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Kendi kendine öğretti' cümlesinde 'kendine' dönüşlü bir zamirdir.

meanings.en: done as an automatic reaction without conscious thought
meanings.exampleEn: Blinking is a reflexive response to bright light.
meanings.exampleTr: Göz kırpmak, parlak ışığa karşı refleks halinde bir tepkidir.

meanings.en: of crucial importance in relation to the development or success of something
meanings.exampleEn: She played a pivotal role in the company's turnaround.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin toparlanmasında kilit bir rol oynadı.

meanings.en: to compensate someone for harm or loss
meanings.exampleEn: The company agreed to indemnify its clients against any losses.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, müşterilerini herhangi bir zarara karşı tazmin etmeyi kabul etti.

meanings.en: to protect someone against future legal liability
meanings.exampleEn: The contract indemnifies the contractor from third-party claims.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme, yükleniciyi üçüncü taraf taleplerine karşı güvence altına alır.

meanings.en: the process of bringing together separate parts into a single whole
meanings.exampleEn: The unification of the two countries took many years of negotiation.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ülkenin birleşmesi uzun yıllar süren müzakereler aldı.

meanings.en: not controlled or limited in any way
meanings.exampleEn: The children showed unrestrained joy when they saw the presents.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar hediyeleri görünce dizginlenmemiş bir sevinç gösterdi.

meanings.en: to place or insert something between two things
meanings.exampleEn: He interposed his body between the child and the traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Vücudunu çocukla trafiğin arasına koydu.

meanings.en: to say something that interrupts a conversation
meanings.exampleEn: "May I interpose a question?" she asked politely.
meanings.exampleTr: "Bir soru sorabilir miyim?" diye kibarca araya girdi.

meanings.en: a person who favours international cooperation and a global rather than national outlook
meanings.exampleEn: As a committed globalist, she argued for open borders and free trade.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararlı bir küreselci olarak açık sınırları ve serbest ticareti savundu.

meanings.en: a person who believes their country should avoid involvement in other countries' affairs
meanings.exampleEn: The isolationist opposed sending troops abroad.
meanings.exampleTr: İçe kapanmacı, yurt dışına asker gönderilmesine karşı çıktı.

meanings.en: dug up something, especially a body, that had been buried
meanings.exampleEn: The remains were disinterred for further examination.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalıntılar daha ayrıntılı inceleme için mezardan çıkarıldı.

meanings.en: brought something forgotten back to attention
meanings.exampleEn: The journalist disinterred an old scandal from the 1980s.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazeteci 1980'lerden kalma eski bir skandalı gün yüzüne çıkardı.

meanings.en: the process of trying to help two sides in a disagreement reach an agreement
meanings.exampleEn: The dispute was settled through mediation rather than in court.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşmazlık mahkeme yerine arabuluculukla çözüldü.

meanings.en: the quality of being unwilling to accept new ideas or the opinions of others
meanings.exampleEn: His narrow-mindedness prevented him from considering other cultures.
meanings.exampleTr: Dar görüşlülüğü, başka kültürleri değerlendirmesini engelledi.

meanings.en: in a way that is a natural, essential part of something
meanings.exampleEn: Extreme sports are inherently dangerous.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekstrem sporlar doğası gereği tehlikelidir.

meanings.tr: dıştan, dışsal olarak, sonradan gelen bir şekilde
meanings.en: in a way that comes from outside and is not an essential part of something
meanings.exampleEn: The value was extrinsically determined by market demand rather than the object itself.
meanings.exampleTr: Değer, nesnenin kendisinden değil, dışsal olarak piyasa talebiyle belirlendi.

meanings.en: contrary to what one would intuitively expect
meanings.exampleEn: It seems counterintuitive, but eating fat doesn't necessarily make you fat.
meanings.exampleTr: Sezgilere aykırı görünse de yağ yemek sizi mutlaka şişmanlatmaz.
